name: Feeling God's presence
promise: Six days of teaching on recognising, sensing and hosting the presence of God, until He feels near again.
why: God's presence is not reserved for special meetings or special people. Across these six sessions the Apostle teaches from Jacob at Bethel, from the witness of the Holy Spirit within, from the Song of Songs and from Moses in Exodus 33 that His presence can be recognised, sensed, invited and carried into ordinary days. If God has felt distant, this path is a gentle way back: learn to notice Him, make room for Him, refuse to move without Him, and be refreshed in Him again.

days.key_quote: You must be able to first recognize the presence of God.

days.theme: He dwells in you: learning His witness
days.key_quote: A witness from the Holy Spirit is actually an impression from the Spirit of God on your heart.
Your knowledge of God is not cerebral; it is experiential.

days.theme: Gathering in His name invites His presence
days.key_quote: We understand how to invite his presence, because our gathering is not for man, but we gather under his authority.

days.theme: Refusing to go without His presence
days.key_title: If You Don't Go, We Won't Go
days.key_quote: If your presence would not go with us, there is no need for us to advance.

days.theme: Times of refreshing from His presence
days.key_quote: Any man that doesn't have access to consistent refreshing in the Kingdom will become stale.
